tail: Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God and the God of our fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob, the great, mighty and awe-inspiring God, God the Most High, who performs acts of kindness and owns everything and remembers the good deeds of the fathers and will bring a redeemer for their children’s children for His Name’s sake in love.
Remember us for life, O King who delights in life, and inscribe us in the book of life for Thy sake, O living God.
O King, helper and saviour and shield, blessed art Thou, O Lord, the shield of Abraham.
